headline_marked: Family of 4 killed in Rangpur: [[Funeral rites completed]] as kin demand justice
headline: Family of 4 killed in Rangpur: Funeral rites completed as kin demand justice
summary: Relatives and locals expressed intense anger and demanded a swift investigation into the brutal killing of a teacher's family in Rangpur city.
details: Funeral rites for the four members of a teacher's family killed in Rangpur city were completed on Tuesday, August 25.
The rituals were held from morning until night at the house and nearby temple in Machhuapara, following Hindu traditions.
The ceremony was attended by people from various professions, including Mahfuz Un Nabi Don, the administrator of Rangpur City Corporation.
Despite the prayers for the souls of the deceased, relatives and locals expressed deep grief and intense anger over the brutal killings.
They demanded a thorough and rapid investigation to uncover the mystery of the massacre and bring the perpetrators to justice.
Administrator Mahfuz Un Nabi Don urged the public to provide any critical information to law enforcement agencies to help solve the case.
He asked for patience, stating that law enforcement needs reasonable time to uncover the actual mystery behind the killings.
He also warned citizens to be cautious and not let any individual or group misrepresent the facts for political purposes.
caption:
Four members of a teacher's family were killed in a brutal massacre in Rangpur. Now, as their funeral rites end, the community demands justice.

Funeral rites for the four members of a teacher's family killed in Rangpur city were completed on Tuesday, August 25.

The rituals were held from morning until night at the house and nearby temple in Machhuapara, following Hindu traditions.

The ceremony was attended by people from various professions, including Mahfuz Un Nabi Don, the administrator of Rangpur City Corporation.

Despite the prayers for the souls of the deceased, relatives and locals expressed deep grief and intense anger over the brutal killings.

They demanded a thorough and rapid investigation to uncover the mystery of the massacre and bring the perpetrators to justice.

Administrator Mahfuz Un Nabi Don urged the public to provide any critical information to law enforcement agencies to help solve the case.

He asked for patience, stating that law enforcement needs reasonable time to uncover the actual mystery behind the killings.

He also warned citizens to be cautious and not let any individual or group misrepresent the facts for political purposes.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV

headline_marked: Ex-president's former wife [[Bidisha Siddique arrested]] in fraud case
headline: Ex-president's former wife Bidisha Siddique arrested in fraud case
summary: Police arrested the former spouse of former President Hussain Muhammad Ershad in Gulshan, Dhaka, in connection with a 2008 fraud case.
details: Police have arrested Bidisha Siddique, the former wife of former President Hussain Muhammad Ershad, from the Gulshan area of Dhaka.
The arrest is linked to a fraud case filed in 2008.
Bidisha Siddique was previously married to the former president, a relationship that was widely publicized and controversial during their time together.
Following her arrest, she is being processed by law enforcement for the legal proceedings related to the case from over 15 years ago.
caption:
A former president's ex-wife arrested in Dhaka. 

What's the story behind the 2008 fraud case?

Police have arrested Bidisha Siddique, the former wife of former President Hussain Muhammad Ershad, from the Gulshan area of Dhaka.

The arrest is linked to a fraud case filed in 2008.

Bidisha Siddique was previously married to the former president, a relationship that was widely publicized and controversial during their time together.

Following her arrest, she is being processed by law enforcement for the legal proceedings related to the case from over 15 years ago.
